title: markdown-index wikilink graph
description: The graph of wikilinks, inline tags, and front matter edges: every edge keyed by its content address, the same address EdgeCID computes. Identical edges share a content address and dedupe to a single entry.

wikilink.title: markdown-index wikilink
wikilink.description: One graph edge: a resolved wikilink, an inline tag, or a front matter edge.

label.description: WEBSITE when a body wikilink target begins http:// or https://, INTERNAL for every other body wikilink. TAG is an inline #tag in the markdown body. FRONTMATTER_INTERNAL, FRONTMATTER_WEBSITE, and FRONTMATTER_TAG are the same shapes found in a front matter string, including an inline markdown link. TAG and FRONTMATTER_TAG carry the text without # in both title and to_document_id, and neither resolves to a document UUID. A front matter tags list of bare words does not produce a label.

title.description: The pipe alias when the wikilink has one, otherwise the raw target text. For a markdown link, the link text. For a TAG or FRONTMATTER_TAG edge, the tag text without the leading #.

from_document_id.description: UUID of the document holding the reference. Only documents with a non-empty UUID produce edges.

to_document_id.description: The target's UUID when a wikilink resolves in the index, otherwise the raw target text. A markdown link keeps its destination as written. For a TAG or FRONTMATTER_TAG edge, the tag text, not a document UUID.
